mean_en: When you say what happened or was the case originally, you are saying what happened or was the case when something began or came into existence, often to contrast it with what happened later.
sentence: Originally, there was merely a piece of waste land.
sentence_trans: 最初，这里只是一块荒地。
word_etyma: origin起源 ＋ ally...地 → originally最初，起初
